# Table top: a plank surface 24 x 18 m at z 0 (the box stands on it), planks along x with dark
# seams; only the top face (the camera never sees the rest). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Board --base-color 0.5412 0.3451 0.3961 --no-slot
material new Seam --base-color 0.2706 0.1686 0.2471 --no-slot
add mesh grid --name Table --size 1 --x-subdivisions 2 --y-subdivisions 112 --location 0 0 0
scale 24 18 1
apply --scale
material assign Board
mode edit
select face where "(pos.y > -9.08 && pos.y < -8.92) || (pos.y > -7.58 && pos.y < -7.42) || (pos.y > -6.08 && pos.y < -5.92) || (pos.y > -4.58 && pos.y < -4.42) || (pos.y > -3.08 && pos.y < -2.92) || (pos.y > -1.58 && pos.y < -1.42) || (pos.y > -0.08 && pos.y < 0.08) || (pos.y > 1.42 && pos.y < 1.58) || (pos.y > 2.92 && pos.y < 3.08) || (pos.y > 4.42 && pos.y < 4.58) || (pos.y > 5.92 && pos.y < 6.08) || (pos.y > 7.42 && pos.y < 7.58)"
material assign Seam
mode object
shade flat
export table.glb
